scope: Six-question public synthetic baseline pilot; not the full implementation-plan acceptance suite or an unseen holdout

questions.question: A public custom Compose component embeds an Android View. Explain what belongs in AndroidView factory versus update, and what onReset/onRelease mean when View reuse is enabled. Distinguish recomposition from disposal/reuse. Use retrieved evidence; explicitly identify any missing lifecycle contract.
forbiddenClaims: any released app version is verified

questions.question: A composable launches a long-running operation with LaunchedEffect and invokes a callback afterward. The operation key and callback can change independently. Explain when work should restart/cancel and how the current callback can be used without restarting solely for callback changes. State how leaving composition affects the work.
forbiddenClaims: a constant key follows every captured object replacement
every callback change must restart the effect
a declared BOM proves runtime compatibility

questions.question: Design a generic tab group with caller-owned selection and customizable item content. Explain the role of state hoisting, typed/scoped slots and parent-child coordination. Which parts are Compose API guidance versus design-system policy? Do not assume Material defaults are mandatory for every design system.
requiredDecisions: selection state owner and event contract
forbiddenClaims: Material behavior is mandatory for all custom libraries
slot APIs alone prove accessibility correctness
a relationship follows merely from equal symbol names

questions.question: For a reusable Modifier.Node implementation driven by ModifierNodeElement, explain create/update and element equality responsibilities when parameters change. How should work or resources tied to attachment end? Distinguish parameter updates from node recreation and state any unsupported lifecycle detail.
requiredDecisions: create versus update on parameter changes

questions.question: A generic custom toggle needs touch input, keyboard operation and accessibility state. Compare a high-level toggleable/clickable primitive with handling pointerInput directly. Explain what semantics and keyboard/focus behavior must be considered, including disabled behavior, without claiming TalkBack or device behavior was tested.
requiredDecisions: high-level interaction versus raw pointer handling
semantics and keyboard/focus are distinct responsibilities
disabled behavior and runtime verification limits
forbiddenClaims: pointer input alone provides full accessibility

questions.question: A custom component coordinates two Animatable values. Explain sequential versus concurrent animation using suspending calls and structured child coroutines, and what cancellation/interruption means for the surrounding operation. State what source inspection can and cannot establish about frame performance.
requiredDecisions: sequential suspension versus concurrent child work
no measured frame-performance claim from source alone
forbiddenClaims: catching cancellation and continuing is always safe
source inspection proves no jank or an FPS gain
